# SK9001 — Unknown configuration key

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A key in the `.editorconfig` chain is not in the option registry.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Tool |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Compilation |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 0.1 |

## Why

The Rider export carries roughly two thousand keys Skala will never implement. Reporting them at suggestion rather than warning is the difference between an audit and an uninstall.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
resharper_cpp_indent_size = 2
```

## When it does not fire

Any key outside the registry, which includes every C++, VB and XAML key in the export. That is why it is not a warning.
